Message from a parent
---------------------

My son is 7. He was diagnosed autistic at 4 and he has significant learning delay — he
has an EHCP and is in a specialist setting. He also has quite a large head, which the
paediatrician has measured a few times and mentioned.

Back in 2019 they did a genetic test. I think it was called an array? The letter said it
was normal and nobody has mentioned genetics since. We're in Manchester, seen at the local
children's hospital.

Someone in a parents' group said we should have had "the full sequencing" done and that
things have moved on a lot since 2019. Is that right, and if it is, who do I even ask?
Our paediatrician appointment is in three weeks.
